## Results and recovery

- Original mcp.json contains the correct URL but no auth. Initial doctor returned 401 invalid_to
ken. Supplying MCP_SERVER_TOKEN recovered connectivity; authenticated doctor status is ready. Token values are not saved. Original
mcp.json is preserved unchanged; scripts read the credential from the environment.\n- MCPJam Cloud existing suite suite_fixture (
Arithmetic smoke), run run_fixture_1: completed/passed, 1/1. Its receipt explicitly labels execution SIMULATED, with no hosted mod
el or live billing. The iteration receipt includes add(2,3) returning structuredContent.sum=5. This is not evidence of live hosted
inference.\n- Direct MCPJam tool checks: 6/7 passed. Positive, negative, decimal, zero sums correct; missing argument and string
argument rejected with isError=true.\n- FAIL: add({\\\"a\\\":2,\\\"b\\\":3,\\\"c\\\":4}) succeeds with sum=5 despite its inputSche
ma declaring additionalProperties=false. See extra-property.json and authenticated doctor tool schema. A server maintainer must en
force the advertised schema for tools/call arguments and redeploy. If extra keys are intentionally supported, the published schema
must instead describe that behavior. No server source was accessed or edited.\n- Protocol 2025-11-25: 13 applicable checks passed
, 1 failed, 30 not applicable. Failed wire-schema-valid flags the GET 405 body {\\\"error\\\":\\\"Use POST\\\"} as non-JSON-RPC. g
et-stream-or-405 itself passed. The transport specification permits GET 405 and does not require its body to be a JSON-RPC respons
e; this appears to be a checker false positive, not a confirmed server defect. Raw report is preserved without changing its failed
outcome. No claim of full conformance is made.\n- Hosted project health skipped the server because hosted probing requires HTTPS.
Local CLI reached HTTP successfully. For a real hosted reachability verdict, provide a hosted-accessible HTTPS endpoint (or an au
thorized tunnel) with the server credentials configured for that connection.\n- Hosted eval steps and trace routes returned NOT_FO
UND: \\\"Synthetic fixture does not implement this route.\\\" Run status and iterations were available and saved; detailed hosted
